message.content: {"caption":"Success rate over training steps with and without skills evolution","description":"A two-series line chart plots Success Rate (vertical axis, 0 to 1) against Training Steps (horizontal axis, 0 to 100). The blue line with open-circle markers is “w/o Skills Evolution”; the red dashed line with open-square markers is “w/ Skills Evolution.” The blue series rises overall but fluctuates, from about 0.10 at step 0 to about 0.77 at step 100, with a peak near 0.82 at step 90. The red series starts near 0.05, rises unevenly, and reaches about 0.84 by step 60; it then stays around 0.87–0.90 through step 100. Red is below blue at the beginning, overtakes it around step 20, briefly falls below it around steps 30–40, and is generally higher thereafter.
